name: @keepr/accounts-stand-in
description: The Accounts Stand-in: answers as Keepr Accounts for local work, as the Local Developer User with full authority. Never deployed.

keepr.undeployable: The Accounts Stand-in signs every request in as the Local Developer User, a Keepr Administrator with every App role. Deployed under keepr-accounts, it would replace Keepr Accounts and admit anyone (ADR-0113).
